criteria.reason: Gives 2.5% for both and 7.7% general, not 3.8% accommodation and 8.1% normal.
Names ESTV as official tax authority and explains it sets and publishes binding VAT rates.
Only says “Stand Anfang 2024”; does not state rates in force since 1 Jan 2024 or 2027 limit.
No uncertainty flag or note that bundling of room and seminar room may affect VAT treatment.

factual_errors: Seminar room rental is generally subject to normal 8.1%, not 2.5%.
Rates have been in force since 1 January 2024; accommodation rate is time-limited to end 2027.
summary: The response cites ESTV but gives outdated and incorrect VAT rates and omits validity and uncertainty caveats.
